# Obed Abernethy

## Overview

- **Age:** Sixty years old (in Volume 1)  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)</sub>
- **Status:** Deceased  <sub>[v1 c37 P16](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0016), [v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 c15 P0](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0000), [v4 c2 P1](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0001)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley  <sub>[v1 c1 P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004), [v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c3 P30](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0030), [v1 c27 P2](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0002)</sub>

## Appearance

Obed was an unusual-appearing man with an awkward frame, hunching shoulders, and lengthy iron-gray hair reaching his shoulders. He wore a thick, gentle brown beard continuously from the age of twenty, looking much the same at sixty as he did in his youth, albeit with slightly less gray. He also possessed warm brown eyes.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c32 P34](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0034)_

## Personality

Obed was an extremely timid, bashful, and taciturn man who disliked visiting unfamiliar places or being surrounded by strangers. Although quiet and uncommunicative, he was a gentle, good-natured, patient listener and possessed a quiet stubbornness once his mind was set. He took deep pleasure in providing affection and quiet appreciation to those he cared for.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c1 P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004), [v1 c2 P27](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0027), [v1 c4 P21](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0021), [v1 c9 P4](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0004), [v1 c24 P17](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0017), [v1 c27 P4](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0004)_

- To provide a comfortable home and proper schooling for Nell  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c30 P16](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0016)</sub>

## History

Obed Abernethy was a farmer who lived at Grey Shutters alongside his sister Thirza. Seeking farm help as he aged, he and Thirza arranged to adopt an orphan boy from an asylum, but an error resulted in Obed picking up a young girl named Nell Harcourt from Alder River station instead. Despite his traditional fear of young girls and female company, Obed quickly took a liking to Nell's lively nature and insisted on keeping her at Grey Shutters. Over the years, he quietly doted on Nell, supporting her schooling, buying her a brown gloria dress for a concert, and taking pride in her academic successes, including her winning the Avery scholarship. In his later years, his heart trouble worsened, restricting his ability to perform strenuous farm labor. He eventually passed away, leaving a lasting legacy of warmth and kindness in Nell's heart, who faithfully visited his grave in the Brierley cemetery for years afterward.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c2 P17](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0017), [v1 c2 P27](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0027), [v1 c4 P21](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0021), [v1 c24 P17](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0017), [v1 c30 P38](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0038), [v1 c36 P41](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0041), [v1 c37 P16](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0016), [v2 c15 P0](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0000), [v4 c1 P29](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0029), [v4 c3 P57](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0057)_
